name: EPIC 212309145
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 8.4 solar radii and 0.81 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,561 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.81 solar masses and 8.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,786 K at its surface.
